maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from operating prisons, detention centers, reentry centers and electronic monitoring under government contracts, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are government agencies (federal, state, international) paying for secure facility management, ICE detention, reentry and electronic monitoring.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from contract awards and facility activations; acquisitions such as BI Incorporated were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Government agencies rely on GEO to run secure facilities with detainees; switching involves transfers, contract rebids and regulatory compliance.
